description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs (trillion floating-point operations) on the x-axis and Loss Ratio (%) on the y-axis for five different model configurations: Vanilla, SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=128), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The x-axis is logarithmic, ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with major tick marks at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 5e8, 1e9, 2e9, 5e9, and 9e9 (though only up to 9e8 is labeled). The y-axis is linear, ranging from 94% to 100%, with tick marks at every 1% interval. The “Vanilla” model (purple triangles, solid line) maintains a nearly constant loss ratio around 100% across all TFLOP values. “SepLLM (n=64)” (orange squares, solid line) starts at approximately 98.3% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises to ~100.2% at 4e8 TFLOPs, then slightly declines to ~99.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs. “SepLLM (n=128)” (blue crosses, solid line) begins at ~97.0% at 1e7 TFLOPs, climbs to ~99.9% by 5e7 TFLOPs, and remains near 99.8–100.0% through 9e8 TFLOPs. “SepLLM (n=64, H)” (green diamonds, solid line) starts at ~97.5% at 1e7 TFLOPs, increases to ~100.0% by 5e7 TFLOPs, and fluctuates slightly around 99.9–100.1% up to 9e8 TFLOPs. “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” (red circles, solid line) begins at 94.0% at 1e7 TFLOPs, rises steeply to ~97.2% at 5e7 TFLOPs, continues climbing to ~99.1% at 3e8 TFLOPs, peaks at ~99.2% at 4e8 TFLOPs, dips to ~98.5% at 5e8 TFLOPs, then stabilizes around 98.8–99.0% through 9e8 TFLOPs. All lines are solid with distinct markers, and the legend is positioned in the lower-right quadrant of the plot.
